#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& stream;
    vector<char> buf;
    size_t curChar;
    size_t numChars;

    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars == (size_t)-1) throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars == 0) return -1;
            curChar = 0;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int peek() {
        if (numChars == (size_t)-1) return -1;
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars == 0) return -1;
            curChar = 0;
        }
        return buf[curChar];
    }

    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    long long readLong() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        long long res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    string readString() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        string res;
        do {
            res.push_back(c);
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

    int readCharacter() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        return c;
    }

    double readDouble() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        double res = 0;
        while (!isSpaceChar(c) && c != '.') {
            if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {
                return res * pow(10, readInt());
            }
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = read();
            double m = 1;
            while (!isSpaceChar(c)) {
                if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {
                    return res * pow(10, readInt());
                }
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                m /= 10;
                res += (c - '0') * m;
                c = read();
            }
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }
    // Other methods omitted for brevity, not used in current problem
    string next() { return readString(); }
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    ostream& stream;

    OutputWriter(ostream& s) : stream(s) {}

    void printLine(int value) {
        stream << value << "\n";
    }
};

class Task {
public:
    virtual void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) = 0;
};

class A : public Task {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) override {
        string str = in.next();
        int ret = 0, n = str.length(), c = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (str[i] != str[i - 1]) {
                ret += c % 2;
                c = 0;
            } else {
                c++;
            }
        }
        ret += c % 2;
        out.printLine(ret);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);
    unique_ptr<Task> solver = make_unique<A>();
    solver->solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
